chaosclubco.sub: Twelve months under a parent org that has three products and no flagship. Marketplace distribution → Ample MVP → FissionPrompt → consolidation. The May 2026 pivot dropped peer-support framing entirely. This arc tests whether the portfolio thesis holds or whether one product earns the focus and the rest sunset.

quarters.subtitle: May → Jul 2026 · claude-code-plugins-plus has shipped, the question is who finds it

months.title: Marketplace distribution strategy decision
weeks: Audit claude-code-plugins-plus current state. Confirm 244 plugins installable.
Distribution path decision: marketplace listing vs blog launch vs Anthropic partnership.
README + landing page polish for whichever path is chosen. Demo flow recorded.
Launch sequence drafted. Outreach list built. Date locked.
months.gate: Marketplace distribution strategy decision · launch path locked

months.title: Launch executed
weeks: Launch day execution. Coordinated post + outreach + community shares.
Week 2 metrics review. Install count, install-to-active ratio.
First wave of feedback triaged. Top 5 plugin issues identified.
Top issues patched. Second outreach wave to fence-sitters.
months.gate: Launch executed · first 100 installs measured · feedback loop active

months.title: Marketplace gets to first stable state
weeks: Plugin contribution guide drafted. PR template + review process.
First external contributor onboarded. PR merged.
Plugin spotlight content: write up 5 best plugins as standalone posts.
Q1 retro: distribution honest assessment. Marketplace viable solo product or feeder?
months.gate: Marketplace gets to first stable state · plugin contribution path opens

quarters.subtitle: Aug → Oct 2026 · scope locked, Figma file activated, ship to closed beta

months.title: Ample scope locked
weeks: Ample current state audit. What exists vs what is in the Figma file.
Scope decision: v1 minimum surface area. Cut everything optional.
Spec written: features in, features out, what success looks like.
Figma file synced to v1 spec. Designer-engineer handoff doc.
months.gate: Ample scope locked · v1 spec written · Figma file aligned to spec

months.title: Ample core feature shipped
weeks: Core feature build W1: foundation + auth.
Core feature build W2: primary user flow shipped end-to-end.
Core feature build W3: feedback capture mechanism built in.
5 closed beta users invited. Feedback loop activated.
months.gate: Ample core feature shipped · 5 closed beta users active

months.title: Mid-year: Ample v1 stable
weeks: Ample week 1 production feedback. Top 3 bugs triaged.
Bug fixes + UX polish based on beta data.
Marketplace 500-install gate check. Trajectory honest review.
Brand voice doc first draft. 14 pillars activated or pruned with evidence.
months.gate: Mid-year: Ample v1 stable · marketplace at 500+ installs · brand voice draft

quarters.subtitle: Nov 2026 → Jan 2027 · second product proves the portfolio thesis

months.title: FissionPrompt v0.2 scope locked
weeks: FissionPrompt current state audit (last commit Nov 2025).
Sequencing decision: parallel with Ample or sequential after Ample stable?
v0.2 scope written. Cut everything not on the critical path.
Build kickoff. Resource allocation against FF + Memoir lanes documented.
months.gate: FissionPrompt v0.2 scope locked · sequencing vs Ample decided

months.title: FissionPrompt closed alpha
weeks: Alpha build W1: core generation pipeline operational.
Alpha build W2: 3 example videos shipped publicly with case-study framing.
Alpha user onboarding: 3 trusted testers invited.
Alpha feedback triage. Top issues prioritized.
months.gate: FissionPrompt closed alpha · 3 video generations shipped publicly

months.title: Portfolio thesis tested
weeks: Three products evaluated against actual use + revenue + brand fit.
Chaos Collective vs ChaosClubCo brand question: rebrand, separate surface, or kill?
Decision documented with evidence. Brand voice doc updated to reflect.
Q3 retro: which product earns more investment, which gets sunset.
months.gate: Portfolio thesis tested · Chaos Collective vs ChaosClubCo decision

quarters.subtitle: Feb → Apr 2027 · one flagship surfaces or the portfolio shape rejected honestly

months.title: Brand voice doc finalized
weeks: Brand voice doc audit. Three flagged pillars (#6, #7, #13) resolved.
Brand voice integrated into all marketplace + Ample + FissionPrompt surfaces.
Content style guide finalized: post structure, voice rules, lane discipline.
Brand audit external review (Lafu or trusted reader).
months.gate: Brand voice doc finalized · 14 pillars resolved (kept, reworded, dropped)

months.title: One flagship surfaces
weeks: Three-product evaluation: distribution, use, revenue (if any), strategic leverage.
Flagship decision: marketplace, Ample, FissionPrompt, or new product entirely.
Investment concentration: 70% to flagship, 30% maintenance to others.
Y2 portfolio shape written. Decision rationale captured.
months.gate: One flagship surfaces · investment concentration decision

months.title: Y2 strategy locked
weeks: Y2 strategy first draft. Single-product vs portfolio reaffirmed.
Lane discipline retrospective: any FF or Memoir bleed during the year?
ChaosClubCo identity statement finalized. Public-facing positioning consolidated.
Y2 plan locked. Year-one closing reflection captured for the project file.
months.gate: Y2 strategy locked · lane discipline retrospective · ChaosClubCo identity stable

_archived.reason: Retired brand per Kyle's Jun 2026 ruling — absorbed by Abstrekkt. Superseded by the 'abstrekkt' arc, which already carries the lineage note in its own sub field. Preserved here, not deleted, matching the project's own 03-history convention.
